scope: Real Chromium strict IndexedDB, existing durable AotDatabase inline checkpoint versus optional incremental pager; same compiled AOT engine/catalog/seed. Times include one SQL update, logical publication and checkpoint completion. One warmup; three timing samples by default; GC outside timers. Natural thresholds unchanged (128 records/4 MiB); snapshot phase forces one logical snapshot before UPDATE. Separate I/O and memory probes. Value submissions estimated as UTF8 JSON with binary fields null plus binary view byte lengths and put/get key JSON. Not physical disk I/O, IDB encoding or service/process memory. CDP sampled peaks may miss synchronous transients. Setup/bootstrap, verification, reopen, ACK/GC and network excluded from times and submission counters.
